seasons.plot: In season 2, Tylor's journey as a Jokester and his friendship with Val face the ultimate test. When new doors of opportunity unexpectedly open at rival energy company, FearCo, Tylor's co-workers at Monsters Inc. begin to question his loyalty. As his Laugh Floor partnership with Val is pushed to the brink, Tylor must discover where he really belongs.

episodes.name: A Monstrous Homecoming
episodes.plot: It's Homecoming Weekend at Monsters University, and Tylor Tuskmon is being celebrated as a former Scream King.

translations.value: It's Homecoming Weekend at Monsters University, and Tylor Tuskmon is being celebrated as a former Scream King.

episodes.name: Il C.R.E.E.P. Show
episodes.plot: I dipendenti del MIFT si uniscono a Mike e Sulley per rappresentare la Monsters & Co. al C.R.E.E.P. Show, una convention sull'energia in cui sperano di promuovere il potere della risata ai professionisti del settore.

episodes.name: Setting the Table

episodes.plot: Durante l'annuale partita di softball tra la Monsters & Co. e la Paura & Co., Val cerca di parlare a Tylor di un'offerta di lavoro da parte di Mike e Sulley, ma Tylor è troppo impegnato a pensare al proprio futuro per ascoltare.
